note: weights turn the four token kinds into one unit (input-token equivalents): cache write 1.25x, cache read 0.1x, output 5x of the uncached input price. prices holds the USD list prices used for every cost figure (pricing.js): the legacy units stay only for token_ceiling and the executor budgets, which are written in M units. usdPerMillionInputTokens is the legacy per-family input price, kept in step with prices.families. alerts.ceilingRatio: record-cost.js alerts when a subtask's units (M, as on its usage line) exceed token_ceiling times this ratio; token_ceiling is written '<x> M units' (e.g. 1.2 M units), a legacy value without 'M units' or 'open' gives no ceiling alert. snapshotMaxBytes: agent-usage.js removes the oldest executor traces from usage-snapshot.json over this size (20 MB, provisional, owner 2026-11-06).

prices.note: USD per million tokens at the Anthropic API list price, read 2026-11-12 on https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing. input is the base input price; a cache write costs input x cacheWrite5m or x cacheWrite1h, a cache read input x cacheRead (the model's own value when it has one), output input x output. over: the input price of a prompt above promptTokens. families is the current model of each family, used for a model id not listed and for figures saved without a model id. A list price is not a bill: on a subscription it is the API equivalent.
